background_setting: A large multi-lane signalized intersection in a suburban commercial area under a clear blue daytime sky. Trees and low buildings border the intersection on both sides, and the road continues into the distance. Cross-street signals visible on the side poles face cross-traffic and display red. The traffic signals facing the ego's direction of travel are green and remain green throughout. The road is wide with painted lane markings, including a prominent white left-turn arrow on the ego's lane that is visible in the foreground.

lighting.conditions: Bright, natural midday daylight with mild haze
lighting.direction: High sun, slightly to the upper-left, producing soft short shadows
lighting.shadows: Soft, short shadows under vehicles and from buildings on either side
lighting.illumination_effect: Bright, slightly hazy exposure with neutral color balance; the dashboard reflects a slice of bright sky

aesthetics.composition: Forward dashcam framing with a prominent white left-turn arrow painted on the ego's lane in the lower foreground, the queued vehicles ahead leading the eye toward the curve of the turn; traffic signals and cross-traffic frame the upper-left
aesthetics.color_scheme: Cool sky-blue overhead, warm muted greens of trees, light grey asphalt, white pavement markings, white truck and grey sedan in the queue
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating pavement markings and the regular spacing of lane lines through the intersection

cinematography.camera_motion: Static dashcam mount; apparent left rotation arises from the ego vehicle's continuous left turn through the intersection
cinematography.focus: Lead vehicles and the curve of the left turn through the intersection

context: Suburban arterial autonomous-vehicle dashcam clip executing a continuous queued permissive left turn under green signals

actions.description: The white truck at the front of the queue begins moving smoothly into the intersection and arcing left; the grey sedan immediately ahead of the ego follows; the ego advances behind the sedan; signals facing the ego are green

The truck continues its arc into the cross-street; the sedan follows at matched pace; the ego advances on the heels of the sedan; the painted white left-turn arrow on the ego's lane slides forward through the frame

The ego curves left, following the sedan around the turn; the truck has begun to exit the frame to the left as it completes its turn; trees and buildings to the left of the intersection slide into view
The ego continues curving left through the turn in a continuous flowing motion; the sedan remains directly ahead; signals remain green; the scene composition rotates as the ego completes the arc

text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Foreground of the ego's lane, visible throughout the early seconds, slides forward as the ego advances
text_and_signage_elements.context: Marks the lane as a dedicated left-turn lane

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the queue is at the head of the dedicated left-turn lane with green signals facing the ego. At 0:01 the white truck begins moving forward and arcing left. At 0:02 the grey sedan follows at matched pace. At 0:03 the ego advances behind the sedan and the painted arrow slides forward in frame. At 0:04 the truck continues its arc into the cross-street. At 0:05 the ego begins curving left. At 0:06 the truck has begun exiting frame to the left; the sedan is mid-turn. At 0:07 the ego continues through the turn in continuous motion. At 0:08 the ego has rotated through the bulk of the turn, with the sedan still directly ahead and signals still green.
audio_description: Steady road and tire noise from inside the cabin while in motion, faint wind, low ambient urban hum from the intersection; no speech, music, sirens, or notable effects.
